status: gate-only correction frozen after version 1.0.0 completed with a false terminal gate: the implementation checked every fit was inside the shift bounds but omitted the already-frozen optimizer-convergence requirement; version 1.0.1 requires both without changing any energy selection, model, starting value, bound, uncertainty, benchmark, threshold, fitted result, or failed scientific decision
post_execution_gate_correction: Version 1.0.0 already failed centered RMSE, Spearman ordering, sign agreement, and constant-velocity rejection. Three H-like fits also reported optimizer_success=false while remaining inside their shift bounds. The corrected gate records those convergence failures exactly as preregistered; it cannot convert the failed result into a pass.
purpose: Run a response-independent, leave-one-region-out Fe-K relative-shift diagnostic on the seven frozen detector regions before committing to expensive response and background production.
claim_boundary: This is a calibration and sign-topology diagnostic, not a response-aware plasma measurement, not an SSM sky-region result, and not evidence sufficient to admit a Sigma source term.

empirical_model.template: for each target region, sum only the other six histograms; subtract a broad Gaussian-smoothed continuum from a narrow Gaussian-smoothed spectrum; clip the residual at zero and normalize it
empirical_model.target_model: positive shifted leave-one-out line template plus a positive exponential continuum
empirical_model.velocity_sign: positive fitted energy shift is a blueshift and therefore negative line-of-sight velocity
empirical_model.systemic_reference: subtract the unweighted mean fitted velocity of the seven detector regions separately in every window

uncertainty.method: Poisson parametric bootstrap of all seven histograms with leave-one-region-out templates rebuilt on every draw
uncertainty.combine_statistical_and_systematic: quadrature for conservative per-region diagnostic errors; pointing correlations are retained as a limitation

published_no_ssm_benchmark_kms.source: A2319 paper Appendix A detector-region table; benchmark is read only after candidate fits are complete and never enters optimization

terminal_gate.pass_rule: Authorize full response-aware detector-region spectral production only if every primary gate passes. He-like and H-like results are mandatory diagnostics but do not have to agree because the published data already suggest phase-dependent motion in e_prime.
